label: Commun (appliqué à tous les thèmes)
_comment: Applied to every flow (text API and documents), with and without theme.

PaymentCardNumberRecognizer, AnyDomainEmailRecognizer and the NIR (EXT-08, EXT-23) were on the text routes only (app/themes/extension/identifiers.json, D-015) until phase 2; moved here by decision Q4 of 2026-10-04.
include_theme_recognizers reuses a theme's recognizer by name instead of copying its regex (no duplication, no drift); an unknown name fails startup.

patterns.name: adresse postale française (numéro + type de voie + nom de rue)
initiale(s) + nom de famille (ex: J-M. Costa, S. Haim-Boukobza, A. Amara Petitjean)

payment card number, same regex as Presidio 2.2.364 CreditCardRecognizer (predefined_recognizers/generic/credit_card_recognizer.py, registered for 'en' only, EXT-08); no Luhn check possible in an ad hoc recognizer: false positives accepted (doctrine 0.1), measured; score 0.6 keeps a margin above every threshold, including the code default DEFAULT_SCORE_THRESHOLD=0.5 (EXT-15)
email address with any domain, including internal ones (.local, .lan, .internal) rejected by Presidio's EmailRecognizer TLD check (EXT-23); simplified dot-atom addr-spec (RFC 5322 s.3.4.1)
